newsitem.title: UK: IMS Group Limited to seek full market listing.
newsitem.headline: IMS Group Limited to seek full market listing.

text.p: Britain's IMS Group Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to seek a full London Stock Exchange listing in early 1997.

IMS, which provides value-added telephone products and services, was formed in 1992 through a venture capital-backed management buyout of William Hill Leisure's telephone sports information activities.

"I believe that IMS can continue to generate shareholder value through organic and acquisition-led growth and that our ability to do so will be enhanced as a quoted company," said managing director Bill Wilson.
The proceeds of the float, sponsored by Hambros Bank with HSBC James Capel as broker, will be used to reduce borrowing and to finance product development and acquisitions.
